title: Api
description: Inputs and outputs of the MCP tools and Board API operations that are not domain objects themselves (ADR-0016). Each MCP tool and its HTTP counterpart use the same definitions. Identity, author and disclosure target are never inputs: they come from the caller's registered connection (ADR-0012, ADR-0026).

lageCreateRequest.title: LageCreateRequest
lageCreateRequest.description: Body of the human-only lage_create operation: a new Lage card. The store assigns the id; the author is the human.

cardPage.title: CardPage
cardPage.description: Gate-cleared cards for the caller's target; denied cards are omitted.

denied.description: Cards the gate withheld for the caller's target, by id and reason (ADR-0031).

changedSince.description: Polling (ADR-0032): return only proposals created or decided after this opaque cursor. Pass the `nextCursor` of the previous page.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor: pass it as `cursor` for the next page or as `changedSince` to poll for later changes.

problem.title: Problem
problem.description: Error response (RFC 9457). Never contains card content (ADR-0026).

decisionRecordRequest.title: DecisionRecordRequest
decisionRecordRequest.description: Input of decision_record (ADR-0039): an agent proposes a decision card with the eleven sections; the human accepts. Becomes a create_card proposal. The agent cannot release it for sharing (ADR-0036).

training.description: An agent cannot opt a card in to the training export; only the human sets training (ADR-0017, ADR-0039).

decisionOutcomeRequest.title: DecisionOutcomeRequest
decisionOutcomeRequest.description: Input of decision_outcome (ADR-0039): an agent proposes the outcome of a decision card; becomes a record_outcome proposal.

usageMetricsRequest.title: UsageMetricsRequest
usageMetricsRequest.description: Input of the human-only usage_metrics_get: an ISO week, or nothing for the rolling 7 days before now.

level1PredictRequest.title: Level1PredictRequest
level1PredictRequest.description: Body of the human-only level1_predict (ADR-0035, ADR-0044): run one engine on a Lage. `engine` is `local` (the built-in deterministic engine) or the id of a configured cloud engine. A cloud engine needs the transfer flow: the first call (without `transferId`) answers `confirmation_required` with the previewed envelope; after the human confirmed it (`disclosure_confirm`) the call is repeated with the `transferId` and the single-use `confirmationToken`, and only then is anything sent. `trigger` says why the engine runs; an `assumption_changed` trigger names the changed assumption cards (the service keeps those that are assumption cards of the request, and records `manual` if none is).

engine.description: `local` or a configured cloud engine id.

level1EngineInfo.title: Level1EngineInfo
level1EngineInfo.description: One engine the board may offer: the built-in local engine, a configured cloud engine, or a preset that is listed but not configured (`available: false` with the reason). A cloud engine always needs a per-transfer confirmation and never re-runs by itself.

reason.description: Why the engine cannot be used; fixed wording, never a credential or an address.

level1MoveChange.title: Level1MoveChange
level1MoveChange.description: A player whose predicted move differs from the previous prediction (for highlighting).

level1Result.title: Level1Result
level1Result.description: Answer of level1_predict. `predicted`: the engine ran and `prediction` is the latest for the Lage (an attributed estimate, never a verdict, not a card; ADR-0035, ADR-0036). `confirmation_required`: a cloud engine; `transfer` is the previewed envelope the human must confirm, nothing was sent. `no_players`: no actor card is on the Lage (or none is cleared for the engine), so there is nothing to predict. `superseded`: the board changed while the engine ran, or a later call started; the answer was dropped and nothing is stored (latest wins).

level1GetRequest.title: Level1GetRequest
level1GetRequest.description: Parameters of the human-only level1_get: the Lage (path) and, on demand, the engine's basis.

explain.description: Also return the basis of the local engine for the current board (the per-option breakdown behind its estimate). Ignored for a cloud engine, which gives none.

level1State.title: Level1State
level1State.description: Answer of level1_get: the engines on offer and the latest prediction kept in memory for the Lage, with `stale: true` when the board changed since it was made (compared without the trigger, so undoing a change makes it current again; ADR-0035). `basis` is present only on request and only for the local engine; it is the engine's own breakdown, not a card.

basis.description: Breakdown of the local rules engine for the current board: per player, per option, the feature values with the card ids they come from.

level1EscalateRequest.title: Level1EscalateRequest
level1EscalateRequest.description: Body of the human-only level1_escalate: open a level-2 board analysis for one player of the Lage's latest prediction (ADR-0035). The new Lage asks for that player's next move, with the engine's move options as its options and the cards the engine used placed on it; the prediction itself is not copied. It is linked to the source Lage with a `based_on` edge.
